printed_header: N M E M 0 M | The members of the Conservation Commission and the Town Forest Committee were deeply saddened by the death of their member, Charles L. Porter, who died December 31, 1967. Charlie was Vice Chairman of the Conservation Commission and a member since the Commission was established in 1961. He was Q quiet, friendly, unassuming, efficient member. He always did more than his share and always refused to accept any credit. His advice and judgement did much to shape the present and future of the Lunenburg Conservation program. This event dulls the enthusiasm of the Commission's report which was written before his death. His memory will always be an inspiration to those who endeavor to carry on this cause
